pairs.claim_text: The speaker and others present have heard discussions on illiberalism by Vast As and John Norbert.

pairs.assumption_text: A rise in illiberalism logically implies a threat to liberty.
pairs.claim_text: The biggest threat to liberty is the idea that the ends justify the means.
